div.div: Room panel booking → Exchange → spaceweave

div.div: A booking made on a Cisco Room Navigator or a Crestron panel lands in the room's Exchange mailbox. spaceweave learns of it from a Microsoft Graph change notification, reads the change with a delta query, and records it as a booking with source: calendar. Panels never call spaceweave.
